entities.summary: Fernando Lahille (Fernand Lahille, born August 18, 1861, in Rouen, died July 30, 1940, French-Argentine scientist, ichthyologist and tunicate specialist. Lahille studied science and medicine at the University of Paris, receiving his doctorate in 1891 while publishing extensively.
